_about: Bundled fallback copy of the Jurassic World Alive creature roster (names, rarity, class, hybrid type, version added, and the German names the data feed sometimes uses). Taken from the public Paleo.gg Dinodex pages (English and German) on 2026-10-17. The tracker refreshes it automatically once a day; this copy is only used if that fails, or for creatures newer than the last refresh.
